sources: Owner direction 2026-11-23 (#15648): the skinned human hands and the skinned body are the main golfer model; the capsule hands and the loft body are deprecated and must not appear in new work. This file is the single answer to 'which golfer model is current'. A spec selects its hands and body with subject.hand_visual_backend and subject.body_visual_backend; the skinned hands need the skinned_hand_wrists spec revision, which moves the wrist joints to the skinned hands' wrists, and a pose fitted before that revision needs its arms refitted. Drawing an unrevised spec with skinned hands would misplace them, so an unrevised spec still falls back to the deprecated capsule hands at draw time, and that fallback logs a deprecation warning.

deprecated.reason: Capsule-finger hands (grip_hand_mesh) predate the skinned human hands with the owner-approved grip: trail palm over the lead thumb, ring finger beside the lead forefinger, 30 degree trail trigger spread.
deprecated.still_allowed_for: Left-handed subjects until left-handed skinned hands land (#15652), specs with physical grip picks (subject.grip_config) until the skinned pair is posed from them (#15654), and specs without the skinned_hand_wrists revision until they are migrated (#15648).

deprecated.reason: The lofted segment body predates the skinned CC0 body that the best matches are drawn with.
deprecated.still_allowed_for: Specs not yet migrated to the current model (#15648), and the left-handed and grip-pick specs that keep the capsule hands (#15652, #15654).
